Description:
If server is built with debug sync and debug_sync_timeout option is not set it defaults to 0 (zero). It means that debug sync facility stays disabled.
However, when used, server asserts.

How to repeat:
Start the server without debug_sync_timeout specified in my.cnf

SET GLOBAL debug = '+d,dbug.enabled_commit';
create database test;

Hello Kamil Holubicki ,

Thank you for the report and contribution.

regards,
Umesh

Posted by developer:
 
Added the following note to the MySQL Server 26.10.0 release notes:

In servers built with Debug Sync, an unset debug_sync_timeout could cause some debug 
actions to assert or abort instead of being ignored. A zero timeout now consistently 
disables Debug Sync. 
Our thanks to Kamil Holubicki and the team at Percona for the contribution.
